project.job: Land to Rear of 1-8 Wesley Terrace, Castleside
project.model_title: ES26-080 Land to Rear of 1-8 Wesley Terrace, Castleside - Quotation Q01

views.title: Footings
views.desc: Stepped Nudura ICF footing walls under every block, following the site levels (6in XR35 external, 6in Standard party walls; 2 to 5 courses below FFL), the indicative ground-floor slabs, and the 10G site plan draped on the survey levels.

views.title: Ground-floor ICF, partitions, windows and doors
views.desc: Ground-floor ICF walls with the openings (25 mm head and jamb overfly), ground-floor timber stud partitions (38x89 C16), UPVC windows and doors.

views.title: First floor
views.desc: 253 mm metal-web joists spanning gable to party wall, top-hung on cut-down ledgers fixed to the ICF with Strong-Tie connectors, 22 mm Egger Protect deck (toggle), timber stairs.

views.title: First-floor ICF, partitions and windows
views.desc: First-floor ICF walls to the eaves at 5,320 mm, the gables and party walls to the roof line, first-floor timber stud partitions, UPVC windows.

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Fink trussed rafters at 600 centres with gable ladders on the houses; bungalow hip roofs: 2-ply girder trusses at the hip ends with Fink trusses between, hip ends framed loose with hips, crown and jack rafters (for the manufacturer to price as jack trusses).

views.desc: Complete structure seen from the north.

groups.title: Quotation documents
groups.note: The site plan with the 8 blocks and floor levels, the stepped footing schedule, and per block type (T01 semi, T01 terrace of 3, T02 bungalow): general arrangements (ICF walls and timber partitions), elevations, a section, the roof truss layout and truss profiles, the first-floor joist layout and joist profiles (for supplier quotes) and the timber partition plans. Then the Nudura proposal, load plans, stack sheets and the BOQ package. For pricing, not for construction.
